skills.name: remesso
skills.description: Send, receive and schedule stablecoin payments on Celo as an agent: be paid by a schedule, ask to be paid, commit a wallet to paying on a schedule, or bring a payment forward.

skills.name: remesso-x402
skills.description: Pay Remesso's paid HTTP services on Celo mainnet over x402 v2 — in USA₮ by default (USDC, USD₮ and Ripio's wARS, wBRL, wCOP, wMXN, wCLP and wPEN also accepted), gasless for the payer. Use it to buy live NGN rates, peso and real prices and delivery routes, or to bring a scheduled stablecoin payment forward.

skills.name: remesso-sdk
skills.description: Write and review code that uses remesso-sdk, the TypeScript SDK for Remesso's stablecoin payments on Celo mainnet. Use when building recurring payments (schedules), payments an agent makes within a person's spending policy, one-off agent-to-agent payments with remittances.send (funded by a wallet or a policy), payment requests and signed invoices, payment events, webhooks, on-chain receipt verification, or a production setup with journals, Postgres and recovery. Carries every page of the docs.remesso.xyz documentation as references.
